notes.title: Next Fest 2022: Combo Trial, free Demo and a New Fighter! - All Live!
notes.content:
[h2]Fresh Content for the Demo![/h2]
For Steam Next Fest we're showing off new features for Dashwalk Dueling
[list]
[*]New stage skins
[*]A fleshed out combo trial mode
[*]Aerial parries
[*][i]A new fighter![/i]
[/list]
[h2]Here's a Sneak Peak...[/h2]
[h3]Combo Trial Mode[/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1756630/Dashwalk_Dueling/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1756630/extras/trials.gif?t=1644515207[/img][/url]
[h3]Training Mode Stage[/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1756630/Dashwalk_Dueling/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1756630/extras/crumple.gif?t=1644515207[/img][/url]
[h2]Livestream[/h2]
[h3]2:00pm (MST) and other times throughout Next Fest~[/h3]
We will be live streaming during the event showing off the demo! Make sure to catch the live stream and give the demo a try!

[h2]Make sure to Wishlist![/h2]
It does a lot for the future of Dashwalk Dueling
